value.derivation:
Anchor: s_0329 (6-(alpha-D-glucosaminyl)-1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol, ChEBI:17049) is the last
GPI intermediate in yeast-GEM that carries a formula: C17H28NO17PR2, charge 0. RDKit reproduces
exactly that formula (C17H28*2NO17P, charge 0) from the ChEBI:17049 R-group SMILES, so the anchor
and the R convention are both verified.

Every downstream intermediate (s_0330, s_0334, s_0337, s_0339, s_0338) has NO formula in yeast-GEM
9.0.2, so r_0523 cannot be balanced directly. The formulas are recovered by walking the pathway
from the anchor, taking each step's transferred group from the donor/acceptor pair that IS definite:

  r_0137 (step 3, Gpi12/Gwt1 acylation): palmitoyl-CoA (C37H62N7O17P3S, -4) -> CoA (C21H32N7O16P3S, -4)
          transferred group = C16H30O
          s_0330 = C17H28NO17PR2 + C16H30O = C33H58NO18PR2
  r_0519 (step 5): dolichyl D-mannosyl phosphate (C26H47O9P) -> dolichyl phosphate (C20H37O4P)
          transferred group = C6H10O5 (mannosyl)
          s_0334 = C39H68NO23PR2
  r_0520 (step 6, Mcd4 EtN-P onto Man-I C2): phosphatidylethanolamine backbone (C5H10NO4P)
          minus diglyceride backbone (C3H4O) = C2H6NO3P (phosphoethanolamine)
          s_0337 = C41H74N2O26P2R2
  r_0521 (step 7): + C6H10O5 -> s_0339 = C47H84N2O31P2R2
  r_0522 (step 8): + C6H10O5 -> s_0338 = C53H94N2O36P2R2
  r_0523 (step 9, Gpi13 EtN-P onto Man-III C6): s_0332 = s_0338 + s_1352 - s_0620
          = C53H94N2O36P2R2 + C5H10NO4P - C3H4O = C55H100N3O39P3R2, charge 0.

Element-by-element closure of r_0523 with the derived values:
  LHS  s_0338 C53H94N2O36P2R2 + s_1352 C5H10NO4P  = C58 H104 N3 O40 P3 R2
  RHS  s_0332 C55H100N3O39P3R2 + s_0620 C3H4O     = C58 H104 N3 O40 P3 R2
  charge 0 + 0 = 0 + 0. Balanced in C, H, N, O, P, R and charge.

Independent structural check (RDKit). A SMILES for the KEGG G13044 topology was constructed on the
ChEBI:17049 R-group scaffold (palmitoyl on inositol C2; GlcN alpha1->6 inositol; Man-I alpha1->4
GlcN carrying EtN-P on C2; Man-II alpha1->6 Man-I; Man-III alpha1->2 Man-II carrying EtN-P on C6)
and RDKit returns C55H100N3O39P3R2, charge 0, identical to the additive derivation. The same
scaffold with one fewer EtN-P returns C53H94N2O36P2R2, identical to the derived s_0338. Constructed
SMILES (verification device only, NOT a curated structure):
[1*]C(=O)OC[C@]([H])(COP(=O)(O)O[C@@H]5[C@H](OC(=O)CCCCCCCCCCCCCCC)[C@H](O)[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@H]5O[C@H]1O[C@H](CO)[C@@H](O[C@H]2O[C@H](CO[C@H]3O[C@H](CO)[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@@H]3O[C@H]4O[C@H](COP(=O)(O)OCCN)[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@@H]4O)[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@@H]2OP(=O)(O)OCCN)[C@H](O)[C@H]1N)OC([2*])=O

Second independent check against a tabulated ChEBI formula. CHEBI:52597 is the 2-acyl child of
CHEBI:53060 and is the only member of this family with a deposited structure; ChEBI tabulates
C42H75N4O39P4R3, charge 0. Recomputing the same walk in the all-R convention (inositol acyl left as
R rather than palmitoyl) gives C40H69N3O39P3R3 for the two-EtN-P species and C42H75N4O42P4R3 for the
three-EtN-P species. The C, H, N, P and R counts match CHEBI:52597 exactly; the oxygen count differs
by exactly 3, because CHEBI:52597's deposited SMILES writes the three ethanolamine phosphates as
P-C phosphonates (P(=O)(O)CCN) instead of P-O-C phosphoesters (P(=O)(O)OCCN). RDKit confirms both:
the deposited SMILES gives C42H75N4O39P4R3, and the same SMILES with the three bridging oxygens
restored gives C42H75N4O42P4R3. Swapping the R-acyl on inositol for the explicit palmitoyl that
yeast-GEM's r_0137 forces converts C40H69N3O39P3R3 into C55H100N3O39P3R2, the proposed formula.

Identity of the product. yeast-GEM r_0523 is KEGG R08107 ("Phosphatidylethanolamine + G00149 <=>
1,2-Diacyl-sn-glycerol + G13044"): all four participants map one to one (s_0338 = CHEBI:53059 =
G00149; s_1352 = CHEBI:16038 = C00350; s_0620 = CHEBI:18035 = C00165; s_0332 = CHEBI:53060 = G13044).
KEGG G13044's composition is "(GlcN)1 (Ino(acyl)-P)1 (Man)3 (EtN)2 (P)2", i.e. TWO ethanolamine
phosphates, and its NODE/EDGE block places them on Man-I C2 and Man-III C6. The CHEBI:53060
definition agrees (two EtN-P). The CHEBI:53060 NAME, which yeast-GEM copied verbatim into
s_0332's metName, lists THREE aminoethylphosphoryl groups and writes the Man-III linkage as
(1->6); that name describes the complete precursor G13152 (KEGG R12702 makes G13044 + PE ->
DAG + G13152), not G13044. The reaction stoichiometry, the ChEBI definition and the KEGG reaction
all agree on two EtN-P, so the derived formula follows the stoichiometry, not the name.

Provenance of the wrong formula. In yeast-GEM v8.0.2 s_0332's formula field held the KEGG glycan
composition string "(GlcN)1 (Ino(acyl)-P)1 (Man)3 (EtN)2 (P)2". Commit 2eb8e907 (PR #111,
"Fix/met formulas", merged 2018-05-18) blanked every formula containing "(" and re-inferred it with
COBRA's computeMetFormulae, a mass-balance solver. Because s_0332's only reaction, r_0523, has an
unformulated substrate (s_0338) and two SLIME backbone pseudo-species, the system was
underdetermined and the solver returned C43H44N9O, which contains no phosphorus and a single oxygen.
Every other metabolite touched by that commit received a hand truncation of polymer notation; s_0332
is the only one whose formula was invented by the solver. The value has been unchanged from v8.1.0
through v9.1.1 (2026-08-28).
value.acyl_convention: Mixed, and forced by the model's own stoichiometry. The two sn-1/sn-2 phosphatidyl chains are generic ChEBI R groups ([1*]/[2*]; the ester carbonyl carbon is explicit, the chain radical is R), written 'R2' in yeast-GEM, as in s_3878 C11H16O13PR2, s_0329 C17H28NO17PR2 and s_4002 C32H60N2O31P2R2. The inositol 2-O-acyl is NOT an R group: r_0137 acylates with palmitoyl-CoA explicitly, transferring C16H30O, so every species from s_0330 onward carries an explicit C16 palmitoyl. yeast-GEM therefore fixes no chain length for the phosphatidyl chains and fixes C16:0 for the inositol acyl. In an all-R convention (three R groups) the same species would be C40H69N3O39P3R3.

decomposition_check.error: Not attempted, and not possible. Group-contribution decomposition needs a fully specified structure; this species has two undefined fatty acyl chains (R2) and no structure exists in ChEBI, MetaNetX or KEGG (CHEBI:53060 has null default_structure and null chemical_data). The record delivers a formula correction, not an energy. equilibrator_cache, equilibrator_assets, component_contribution and equilibrator_api are also absent from the torchcell conda env used here.

notes:
What the correction is. yeast-GEM 9.0.2 gives s_0332 the formula C43H44N9O, which has no phosphorus and one oxygen and therefore cannot be a glycophosphatidylinositol. The value is a COBRA computeMetFormulae output produced in PR #111 (commit 2eb8e907, 2018-05-18) after the field's original content, the KEGG G13044 composition string '(GlcN)1 (Ino(acyl)-P)1 (Man)3 (EtN)2 (P)2', was blanked for containing parentheses. The solver was underdetermined because s_0332's only reaction has an unformulated substrate. The error is unchanged in yeast-GEM v9.1.1 (2026-08-28). The proposed value is C55H100N3O39P3R2 at charge 0.

Why the admission is provisional, not tabulated. The rule admits a mass-balance formula correction as tabulated only when the other participants of the reaction are definite species. They are not. s_0338 has no formula at all in yeast-GEM (nor in ChEBI or MetaNetX), and s_1352 and s_0620 are SLIME backbone pseudo-species whose formulas, C5H10NO4P and C3H4O, are not real molecules. The derivation is therefore anchored on s_0329 five steps upstream and closed by three independent checks (additive walk, RDKit on a constructed G13044 scaffold, and agreement with the tabulated CHEBI:52597 formula once its phosphonate drawing error is corrected), but no single tabulated source states C55H100N3O39P3R2.

No structure exists. CHEBI:53060, CHEBI:53059 and the four other members of the series (53055, 53056, 53057, 53058) are class entries with null default_structure and null chemical_data. MetaNetX carries no structure for MNXM38542. KEGG holds G13044 only as a glycan topology, not a molfile. The one structure in the family, CHEBI:52597, is an R-group structure for a different species (three EtN-P, all-R acyl) and it is drawn wrong. So no defined-acyl-chain representative exists to admit, and smiles and inchikey are left null. The SMILES quoted inside value.derivation was constructed here to verify the formula and must not be treated as a curated structure.

Fixing the formula does not unblock r_0523 for FBA. s_0332 is a dead-end metabolite: r_0523 is its only reaction, and yeast-GEM's own qc_findings.md lists it under 'Dead-end metabolites'. The correction removes r_0523 from the thermodynamic exclusion list, nothing more. Because the species has two undefined acyl chains, group-contribution decomposition remains impossible even with the corrected formula, so an energy for r_0523 still cannot be computed by the default route.

Which chain-length convention yeast-GEM uses. Not a fixed chain length. The phosphatidyl chains are generic ChEBI R groups ([1*]/[2*], carbonyl carbon explicit, chain radical implicit), written 'R2' in the GEM: s_3878 C11H16O13PR2, s_3879 C19H29NO18PR2, s_0329 C17H28NO17PR2, s_4002 C32H60N2O31P2R2. The inositol 2-O-acyl is the exception: r_0137 acylates with palmitoyl-CoA explicitly, so a mass-balanced s_0330 onwards must carry an explicit C16 palmitoyl. The proposed formula follows that mixed convention because the model's own stoichiometry forces it. In an all-R convention the same species is C40H69N3O39P3R3.

What a human still has to decide. (1) Whether to adopt the mixed convention above or to switch the whole GPI branch to all-R, which would also require rewriting r_0137 to use a generic acyl-CoA. (2) Whether to fill in the five missing formulas s_0330 C33H58NO18PR2, s_0334 C39H68NO23PR2, s_0337 C41H74N2O26P2R2, s_0339 C47H84N2O31P2R2, s_0338 C53H94N2O36P2R2, all derived here from the same walk; s_0332 alone will not balance the branch. (3) Whether to correct s_0332's metName, which is the CHEBI:53060 name and describes a three-EtN-P species (KEGG G13152) rather than the two-EtN-P G13044 the reaction actually produces.

Upstream defects found along the way, none of them filed. An issue against SysBioChalmers/yeast-GEM is warranted and should cover all of these together, since they are one broken pathway branch: (a) s_0332's formula C43H44N9O; (b) five GPI intermediates with no formula; (c) r_0520 consumes the whole phosphatidylethanolamine backbone and releases no diglyceride backbone, so it transfers C5H10NO4P where the chemistry transfers C2H6NO3P; (d) r_0522 releases no dolichyl phosphate; (e) s_4002 'G00149' duplicates s_0338 (both are KEGG G00149 / CHEBI:53059) with a third formula, C32H60N2O31P2R2, that matches neither, and s_4002/s_4003 sit on an orphan reaction r_4322 disconnected from the r_0518-r_0523 chain. An upstream ChEBI report is also warranted for CHEBI:52597's three P-C phosphonate bonds and for the CHEBI:53060 name-versus-definition conflict. Existing issue #194 is an open umbrella for mass imbalance but names none of this. Nothing was filed.
